scope: Independent read-only source review; no remote execution or new regression runs
confirmed: The consumer pins the exact producer source SHA and expected RESULT digest, checks every candidate snapshot and binary patch digest, compares policy/vendor bindings, and validates the patch path set before application.
Candidate snapshots, policy and vendor contents are checked after generation and regression; non-schema edits are rejected. Protocol source/test bytes are additionally bound independently.

Allowed schema paths must be canonical relative paths under the schema root and end in json/ts/zst. Regular-file checks reject file symlinks. Schema path sets and bytes are frozen before regressions and rechecked afterwards, including deletions.

Real subprocess commands are saved before invocation; combined stdout/stderr and exit code are retained. Regression failure still exports the generated schema snapshots and patch and returns a failing process status.

Workflow uses a single producer job artifact for the current run/attempt, exact checkout, read-only repository permission, disabled credential persistence, and upload on non-cancelled failures. Promotion remains explicitly false.

issue_closed_during_review.finding: A failed second policy check could leave an earlier original_dependency_policy_unchanged=True in the failed receipt.
issue_closed_during_review.fix_rechecked: The current source now sets False before describing policy files and records the comparison result before raising. Missing/symlink policy errors therefore also cannot retain True.
issue_closed_during_review.new_regression_execution: Owned by root; this reviewer did not repeat its tests.

retained_scope_limits: If a required schema-generation command fails before snapshot collection, its log/exit status are preserved, but partially generated schema files are not exported by this script. Full failure-output retention applies to post-generation regression failures.
An idempotent generation with no changed schema paths is deliberately rejected by the current scope guard; this is a conservative false-negative, not a bypass.
Cancellation and runner loss are excluded from upload by !cancelled(); neither this script nor the reviewed workflow guarantees those artifacts.
The current review does not establish that the remote generation command or protocol regressions have run successfully.
review_conclusion: Source/artifact binding and failed-regression retention are coherent within the stated scope; the stale policy field was repaired. Remote execution remains pending.
